Does not build, generate, modify, validate, test, optimize, or convert regular expressions, and does not translate plain-language requirements into patterns. refined_descriptions.doc-critiquer: Reviews draft documents for clarity, structural organization, and missing sections, returning line-level comments. Unlike cron-scheduler, which converts plain-language schedules into validated cron expressions for timed task execution, this skill operates on written prose only. Does not rewrite or edit documents, generate new content, fact-check claims, produce finalized versions, or handle cron expressions, scheduling, or task automation.
refined_descriptions.image-ocr: Extracts text from image files and scanned PDFs using OCR, returning recognized text with coordinates for each text block. Read-only: it never alters, removes, or redacts content, unlike pdf-redactor, which permanently deletes personal data from PDFs. Use this skill when the goal is reading or indexing image-based documents. Does not cover redaction, anonymization, or removal of sensitive or personal data; does not modify, overwrite, or encrypt files; does not process PDFs that already contain a text layer (use native extraction instead).
refined_descriptions.slide-exporter: Converts presentation slide decks into PDF files, image files, or HTML handouts, optionally including speaker notes. Unlike pdf-redactor, which permanently removes personal data from existing PDFs and verifies removal, this skill only changes the output format of a deck and never alters or inspects PDF content for sensitive data. Does not redact, edit, or clean PDF files; does not create or modify slide content; does not convert documents other than slide decks; does not remove personal information from any file type.

refined_descriptions.sql-explainer: Reads an existing SQL query and explains what it does, step by step, in plain language, covering SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, subqueries, and CTEs. Differs from cron-scheduler, which generates and validates cron expressions from plain-language schedule descriptions: this skill takes SQL as input and produces plain-language explanations rather than executable syntax. Does not write, generate, optimize, validate, or execute SQL, does not translate natural language into queries, and does not create cron expressions or schedules.
refined_descriptions.pdf-signature-check: Verifies PDF documents for digital signatures: detects whether signatures are present and validates each one's cryptographic integrity and certificate status. Differs from cron-scheduler, which writes and validates cron expressions from plain-language schedules; this skill handles PDF files and cryptographic signatures only, never scheduling or time-based expressions. Does not create, apply, or remove signatures, sign documents, manage or issue certificates, validate cron expressions, or process formats other than PDF.
refined_descriptions.email-drafter: Drafts replies to customer emails following the support tone guide. Unlike git-bisector, which automatically runs git bisect to locate the commit that introduced a bug in version control history, this skill only composes text responses to support correspondence and does not inspect repositories. Excluded work: sending, forwarding, or scheduling emails; inbox triage; translation; and any debugging or commit-identification tasks, which remain with git-bisector.
refined_descriptions.csv-merger: Merges multiple CSV files into a single file by joining rows that share a value in a specified key column; supports duplicate-key handling and configurable output column order. Unlike csv-cleaner, which repairs formatting within one file (quoting, whitespace, column names), this skill combines files and performs no formatting repairs. Does not clean, validate, filter, split, or aggregate data, and does not convert file formats; run csv-cleaner first if normalization is needed.
refined_descriptions.git-conflict-resolver: Supports explaining merge conflicts on a Git branch and proposing a concrete resolution for each conflict hunk. Differs from cron-scheduler, which only generates and validates cron expressions from plain-language schedules; this skill handles Git conflict analysis and produces no schedules. Does not cover performing merges or rebases, resolving rebase or cherry-pick conflicts, staging or committing changes, rewriting history, or Git configuration.
refined_descriptions.log-anomaly: Scans parsed log records for anomalies, including unusual patterns, error-rate spikes, and suspicious lines, and outputs flagged entries with reasons. Unlike log-parser, which converts raw logs into structured records, this skill consumes already-parsed records and performs detection only; it does not parse raw logs. Excluded work: raw log ingestion, timestamp and level field extraction, log shipping or storage, remediation of flagged issues, real-time alerting, and metric dashboards. Requires structured log input from a parser; output is anomaly flags, not normalized records.
refined_descriptions.api-diff: Compares two OpenAPI specification files and reports breaking changes affecting clients, such as removed endpoints, changed parameter types, or altered response schemas. Unlike email-triage, which classifies inbound support email by intent, urgency and language, this skill operates on API specification documents, not email messages or tickets. Does not generate or validate OpenAPI specs, test live endpoints, fix breaking changes, generate client SDKs, or classify, prioritize, or route email.
refined_descriptions.regex-explainer: Explains an existing regular expression token by token. Input is a complete pattern; output is plain-language descriptions of each token, quantifier, group, character class, and flag. Reverse of regex-builder, which generates a new pattern from a plain-language description and test strings; here the pattern is the input, not the output. Does not build, modify, validate, test, debug, or optimize regular expressions, convert between regex flavors, or explain source code that contains regex.
refined_descriptions.cron-explainer: Decodes existing cron expressions into plain-language explanations of when they run, covering ranges, steps, lists, and day-of-month/day-of-week quirks. Input is a cron expression; output is a readable schedule. Differs from cron-scheduler, which converts plain-language schedules into cron expressions and validates them; this skill works only in the reverse direction. Excludes writing, generating, editing, validating, or fixing cron expressions, scheduling or executing jobs, and non-standard scheduler syntax outside the standard five-field cron format.
refined_descriptions.doc-translator: Translates complete documents between languages while preserving source formatting (layout, styles, tables) and enforcing consistent terminology via glossaries or translation memories. Unlike email-triage, which classifies inbound support email by intent, urgency and language without altering content, this skill converts document text into a target language and never classifies, prioritizes or routes messages. Does not cover: email triage or classification, intent or urgency detection, standalone language identification, real-time chat or speech translation, and file conversion unrelated to translation.
refined_descriptions.image-captioner: Generates descriptive alt-text captions for images by analyzing visual content with a vision model. Unlike doc-summarizer, which condenses long text documents into abstracts, this skill takes image files as input and produces short textual descriptions of visual scenes. It does not summarize text documents, extract or transcribe text within images (OCR), classify or tag image content, or caption video or audio. Supports common image formats such as PNG and JPEG and returns one caption per image.
refined_descriptions.slide-auditor: Audits existing slide decks and reports text overflow, low-contrast or unreadable text, and missing speaker notes. Unlike cron-scheduler, which writes and validates time-based cron expressions for scheduling tasks, this skill performs static analysis of presentation files and contains no scheduling or automation features. It does not create, edit, or redesign slides, does not apply fixes automatically, does not convert file formats, and does not schedule recurring checks; it only returns an assessment of the deck's current state.
refined_descriptions.sql-migrator: Translates SQL queries between database dialects (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, SQLite), rewriting syntax, functions, data types, and quoting for the target engine. Unlike sql-optimizer, which tunes a single query for performance (indexes, join order, partition pruning), this skill only makes statements run on a different engine and does not alter or evaluate execution plans. Excluded work: performance tuning, index recommendations, schema migrations, data transfer, and stored-procedure or application-code porting.
refined_descriptions.pdf-watermarker: Stamps a text watermark across pages of a PDF and reports which pages were changed. Unlike api-diff, which compares two OpenAPI specification files and reports breaking changes between them, this skill modifies a single PDF document by adding visible watermark text; it performs no file comparison. Does not diff or compare documents, extract or edit PDF text, merge or split files, add image or logo watermarks, remove existing watermarks, encrypt or validate PDFs, or generate or validate OpenAPI specs.
refined_descriptions.email-digest: Summarizes long email threads into short bullet digests, preserving sender attribution and reply order, and extracts action items with owners and deadlines. Differs from doc-summarizer, which produces a single abstract with key points from general long text documents and does not handle thread structure or action item extraction. Does not cover summarizing non-email documents (use doc-summarizer), drafting or sending replies, spam filtering, inbox triage, or calendar management.
refined_descriptions.csv-deduper: Detects duplicate rows within a single CSV file and reports which columns matched for each duplicate group, covering full-row duplicates and duplicates defined by a specified subset of columns. Unlike csv-merger, which combines multiple files by joining rows on a shared key column, this skill operates on one file at a time and performs no merging or joining. Does not clean, repair formatting, validate, filter, aggregate, split, or convert file formats; run csv-cleaner for repairs or csv-merger to combine files.
refined_descriptions.git-changelog: Generates a changelog from git commit messages and metadata between two refs (tags, branches, or commit SHAs), formatting entries as release notes. Unlike cron-scheduler, which converts plain-language schedule descriptions into validated cron expressions, this skill reads only git history and outputs changelog text. It does not write, validate, or parse cron expressions, does not schedule or trigger jobs, and does not author commits, compute diffs, or bump version numbers.
refined_descriptions.log-tailer: Watches a live log stream (file, pipe, or stdout) in real time and prints lines matching a given pattern as they arrive. Unlike cron-scheduler, which composes and validates cron expressions for running scheduled jobs, this skill performs no scheduling and produces no cron syntax. It does not write or validate cron expressions, does not schedule tasks, does not search historical or archived logs, does not parse, aggregate, or summarize log contents, and does not rotate or manage log files; it only filters an active stream.
refined_descriptions.api-loadtest: Sends configurable load (concurrent users, request rate, duration, ramp-up) against a running API endpoint and reports latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), throughput, and error rates. Unlike api-mocker, which generates a mock server with fake responses, this benchmarks a live endpoint and produces no mock data or stubs. Excludes mocking, stubbing, or fake response generation (use api-mocker), functional or correctness testing, response body validation, and server-side profiling or tuning.
refined_descriptions.regex-tester: Evaluates a caller-provided regular expression against a list of test strings and reports, per string, whether it matches, the matched text, and capture group contents. Differs from regex-builder, which generates a new pattern from a plain-language description; this skill requires an existing pattern and only executes it. Excluded: writing, generating, or refining regex patterns; translating plain-language requirements into regex; explaining regex syntax.
refined_descriptions.cron-migrator: Converts already-written cron expressions between formats: standard five-field, Quartz, and systemd timer units. Differs from cron-scheduler, which authors new expressions from plain-language schedule descriptions and validates them; this skill performs no authoring or validation, only format translation between dialects. Does not write expressions from natural language, check syntax or schedule correctness, execute scheduled jobs, edit crontab files, or convert non-cron scheduler configs. Route authoring or validation requests to cron-scheduler.
refined_descriptions.doc-critiquer: Reviews draft documents (reports, proposals, specs, memos) for clarity, structure, and missing sections, returning line-numbered comments. Unlike cron-scheduler, which translates plain-language schedules into validated cron expressions, this skill evaluates prose content and never parses schedules or cron syntax. Does not write, rewrite, or apply fixes to document text, does not generate missing sections, and excludes grammar or spell-checking, code review, and any scheduling or cron work.
refined_descriptions.image-ocr: Extracts text from images and scanned PDFs, returning recognized text with word and line positions. Read-only analysis: unlike pdf-redactor, which permanently removes personal data from PDF files with verification, this skill changes nothing and deletes nothing. Does not cover redaction or personal data removal, PDF editing or annotation, converting scans into searchable PDFs, or handwriting recognition.
refined_descriptions.slide-exporter: Converts presentation slide decks (PPTX, ODP, Keynote, Google Slides) into PDF, PNG or JPEG images, or HTML handouts, optionally including speaker notes. Unlike pdf-redactor, which permanently removes personal data from existing PDF files with verification, this skill only performs format conversion of presentations and never alters, redacts, or inspects PDF content. Does not cover data redaction, privacy removal, PDF editing, compression, OCR, or slide deck creation and design. Source decks are left unchanged.
